headline: Power Module
title: Power Module | Unlock E-Mode at RV 12 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want faster Homeland production in Aniimo? Reach R V level twelve and buy the Power Module. It unlocks E-Mode for certain facilities, plus the Crackle Generator and the Crackle Power Pole. The generator only runs when you assign a Lightning Aniimo to it. A facility must sit inside the grid's supply range, and poles extend that range. Facilities on one grid share the power equally. Are you powering up your Homeland? Comment below!
description: In Aniimo's Homeland the Power Module unlocks at RV level 12 and enables E-Mode, the Crackle Generator and the Crackle Power Pole. Generators need a Lightning Aniimo, poles extend the supply range and facilities on a grid share the output.
joke: My Homeland finally has power, now my Lightning Aniimo wants a raise.
